lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to chisel out two new stone tablets, and Moses carries them up Mount Sinai alone.
The LORD descends in a pillar of fire and proclaims His name, and Moses bows down and asks Him to go with them.
The LORD promises a covenant and wonders, and tells Israel to tear down the altars of the land and make no treaty with its people.
Moses stays with the LORD seven days and seven nights without eating bread or drinking water, and writes the Ten Commandments on the tablets.
Moses' face is radiant when he comes down, so he puts a veil over it after speaking to the Israelites.
